name: bada-sokudoku
description: Bada Sokudoku — a speed-reading studio that solves the page as an image. A Swin-style windowed self-attention encoder with shifted windows runs over the patch grid of a scanned or photographed book page; attention rollout inside each window partition, fused with classic run-length smearing, recovers the character clusters, lines, blocks and the reading order (right-to-left for vertical Japanese). The recovered blocks are then lit one after another at a dwell time derived from the reader's perceptual span and target speed, and the whole playback is composited into a single canvas so it can be recorded to WebM as it runs. No OCR, no network, self-contained HTML.
author: Masaaki Yamaguchi
